decision: Production gateway torneos-gateway stays commerce OFF (never receives MERCADO_PAGO_* / TORNEOS_PAYMENT* / TORNEOS_COMMERCE_*). The certified payments runtime runs as a SEPARATE Deno Deploy app torneos-payments-test, TEST only, reached internally by the operator session (HMAC) instead of the gateway. No third Supabase project: the data plane is the existing Arma2 Torneos project, with a dedicated payments login and QA-only fixtures.

remoteTest.trigger: any TORNEOS_PAYMENTS_DB_URL host that is not offline (lab container, loopback, .invalid) requires TORNEOS_PAYMENTS_DEPLOYMENT=remote-test
remoteTest.database: Supavisor pooler aws-<n>-sa-east-1.pooler.supabase.com, login <login>.onzpwnqxnvlgsevivngf, port 5432|6543, database postgres, no query, TORNEOS_PAYMENTS_DB_SSL_CA required
remoteTest.host: requests are served only on the canonical host of TORNEOS_PAYMENTS_NOTIFICATION_URL (403 otherwise)
remoteTest.liveGuard: GET https://api.mercadopago.com/users/me must answer id = MERCADO_PAGO_TEST_SELLER_ID, tags ∋ test_user, site_id MLA before any provider or DB call; not_test is final per isolate

paymentLogin.attributes: LOGIN NOINHERIT, no SUPERUSER / CREATEDB / CREATEROLE / REPLICATION / BYPASSRLS, no connection limit override, no valid-until, no role config
paymentLogin.membership: torneos_payment_service only (admin false, inherit false, set true)
paymentLogin.custody: macOS Keychain arma2-torneos-payments-test / torneos_payments_test (40-char password); the server receives a SCRAM-SHA-256 verifier only
